eod.conclusion: Indian equities closed lower despite early gains, with the Nifty and Sensex both declining over 1%. While morning sessions showed resilience from reduced volatility and earnings anticipation, selling pressure emerged later. Defense stocks outperformed on policy support, contrasting with broader market weakness. The rupee held relatively steady amid central bank efforts to offset external pressures, as global bond markets remained tense over inflation concerns.
